readmeHtml:
EdgeEver

AI-native note-taking app & Evernote/Obsidian alternative. Instant all-platform sync, rich notes (tables, mind maps, diagrams, posters), web clipper & MCP. 100% free on Cloudflare or Docker.

简体中文 | 繁體中文 | English | Español | Deutsch | Français | 日本語 | Polski | Русский

Telegram Group  |  🌐 Live Demo  |  🗺️ Roadmap  |  📱 Clients & Extension  |  Feature Matrix & Capabilities  |  📥 Note Migration

EdgeEver is a modern, open-source notes and knowledge base workspace. It preserves the classic, high-efficiency three-pane productivity workflow (Tree View · Note List · Editor) while offering an open data architecture and seamless AI Agent integration for complete ownership and smart productivity.

💡 Serverless & 100% Free Forever EdgeEver can run within Cloudflare's free quotas with no server purchase or VPS maintenance. Users who prefer a VPS, NAS, or home server can deploy the same application with Docker.

⭐ If EdgeEver is useful to you, consider giving it a Star. Your support helps more people discover the project.

Why EdgeEver

Many users of note-taking apps and personal knowledge bases simply want a reliable, open, and fast personal knowledge base. However, existing mainstream solutions all present tradeoffs:

  • Evernote: Offers the smoothest, most seamless multi-device cloud sync experience. Yet as it evolved into a full-featured commercial suite, ads and add-ons multiplied while system overhead climbed. Meanwhile, free-tier quotas tightened, premium AI subscriptions grew expensive, and it remains difficult to integrate into modern self-hosted and private AI workflows.
  • Obsidian: Open Markdown files, closed-source core. Official Sync requires an ongoing subscription tiered by storage and vault count, while third-party sync (iCloud, WebDAV, Git, etc.) is tedious and conflict-prone; constrained by local-directory file sync and mobile background limits, it struggles to match the seamless, invisible sync of cloud-native note apps (and lacks a full web workspace). Relying on local file scanning causes noticeable cold-start and search lag once notes reach the thousands or plugins pile up; storing attachments alongside notes bloats vaults, slows mobile sync, and leaves orphaned files behind. Combined with an IDE-like UI and plugin-tinkering learning curve, it feels overly heavy for users used to out-of-the-box, capture-anywhere cloud note apps.
  • Joplin: A veteran open-source three-pane note app, yet its UI design and editing experience feel stuck more than a decade in the past, lacking modern polish and fluidity. Fast official sync (Joplin Cloud) requires a paid subscription; free sync via WebDAV or cloud drives relies on file-by-file polling that becomes sluggish on mobile as notes and attachments grow, while self-hosting Joplin Server requires maintaining your own server with no zero-cost serverless option. It also lacks a full browser-based web workspace and native AI Agent capabilities (MCP/ACP).
  • Memos & Stream Notes: Clean and simple, but their social-timeline layouts differ fundamentally from the structured productivity of a classic three-pane workflow.
  • SiYuan & Block-based PKMs: Powerful with self-hosting support, but their UI and interaction feel closer to heavy Obsidian-style PKMs than the intuitive three-pane experience of traditional commercial cloud note apps, and their granular "block-level" architecture also imposes noticeable cognitive overhead for quick daily capture and continuous prose writing. Furthermore, they lack a true zero-cost serverless deployment tier, and multi-device sync relies on paid official subscriptions or paying extra to unlock S3/WebDAV sync features with your own storage.

EdgeEver fills this gap: The entire stack is open source, delivering truly seamless, low-latency, instant multi-device cloud sync with full self-hosting freedom. It keeps the three-pane layout you know, stays silky-smooth and lightweight even with 10,000+ notes, and ships native AI agents with zero-cost deployment.

Online Demo

  • Demo: https://demo.edgeever.org

The public demo resets every day at 3:00 AM (China Standard Time) and restores sample notes. Do not store private content there.

All-Platform Clients & Browser Extension

Client Downloads

           

The iOS app requires an Apple ID from outside mainland China.

Browser Web Clipper Extension

     

  • Extract clean Markdown from web articles, clip selected text and images, or capture custom webpage regions directly to your self-hosted instance.
  • Deep structured clipping for 20+ platforms: social (X, Xiaohongshu, Instagram, WeChat, Jike, Douban, Threads, Bluesky), dev & reading communities (Zhihu, Reddit, GitHub, V2EX, Hacker News, Medium, Substack), and media/podcasts (Bilibili, YouTube, Xiaoyuzhou).

Feature Matrix & Capabilities

An all-in-one workspace connecting inspiration capture, deep creation, and knowledge compounding (👉 Explore 20 step-by-step showcases with screenshots):

Module Core Capabilities & Features
Writing, Organizing & Search • Immersive Dual-Mode Editor: Resizable 3-pane workspace, instant toggle between rich-text WYSIWYG and Markdown, built-in template gallery, math & chemical formulas, syntax highlighting, persistent outline folding, and revision history
• Custom Typography: Customize covers, chapter navigation, prose color palettes, Polaroid image frames, and spacing per notebook or note
• Infinite Hierarchy & Millisecond Search: Unlimited-depth folder trees, tags, drag-and-drop sorting, and batch note merging/moving, paired with instant full-text search and historical filters
• Desktop Multi-Window & Large Attachments: Multi-window editing and automatic writeback for externally edited files; automatic 50%–90% client-side image compression and chunked streaming up to 1 GiB
Multi-Modal Rich Notes & Visuals • AI Multi-Dimensional Tables & Public Forms: Prompt-to-database generation with named views, multi-condition filtering, multi-field sorting, and clickable cell links; publish login-free collection forms in one click
• AI Mind Maps & Architecture Diagrams: Interactive mind maps and live Mermaid flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and architecture diagrams with conversational AI generation
• AI Infographics: Conversational one-click generation of timelines, comparison matrices, quadrant charts, and structured visual cards
• Native Canvas Poster Notes: Built-in canvas-based visual card note type—double-click to edit covers and social visual cards
Omni-Channel Capture & Migration • Browser Clipping & 20+ Platform Parsers: Extract clean articles, clip text/image selections, or capture custom webpage regions; purpose-built parsers for Xiaohongshu, X, Instagram, Zhihu, Reddit, GitHub, YouTube, Bilibili, and more
• Mobile Share & Desktop Screen Capture: Save photos and articles via the mobile share sheet; capture screen regions directly into notes via a global desktop shortcut
• WeChat Chat History Archiving: Import merged WeChat chat transcripts from mobile or desktop in one click, preserving timestamps, quotes, emojis, and media attachments
• One-Click Third-Party Migration: Native GUI import for Evernote, Obsidian, Notion, SiYuan, flomo, Joplin, and Markdown folders with full hierarchies and attachments
Styled Publishing & Knowledge Sharing • Standalone Knowledge Base Sites: Publish entire notebooks as standalone static websites with folder tree navigation and optional password protection in one click
• Single-Note Share Links: Share individual notes with custom slugs, passwords, expiry dates, view counters, collapsible outlines, QR code downloads, and raw Markdown links
• Copy as Rich Text: Preserves formatting and images for pasting directly into WeChat, Zhihu, X Articles, Substack, blogs, and other editors
• Curated Long-Image & Multi-Format Export: Built-in long-image poster themes and Monogram avatars; export to high-res images, code cards, MD, HTML, or PDF
AI & Agent Collaboration • Companion AI Assistant & BYOK: Sidebar AI for summaries, proofreading, translations, and multi-part long-form continuations; compatible with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and custom endpoints with output budget controls
• Native Agent Protocols (MCP & ACP): Built-in Remote MCP with granular per-notebook read/write permissions; desktop ACP to drive local agents such as Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity, CodeBuddy, and WorkBuddy
• AI Audio & Video Transcription: Client-side audio extraction and chunking, connecting directly to OpenAI-compatible speech models to transcribe and insert text into notes
Plugin & Theme Ecosystem • Official Marketplace & Cross-Device Sync: Install extensions in one click from the official marketplace, GitHub repositories, or a Manifest URL, syncing installed plugins and themes across web and desktop workspaces
• Full-Featured Plugin API (@edgeever/plugin-api): Programmatic access to notes, templates, attachments, editor selections & custom embeds, sidebar panels, global commands, built-in AI, and desktop scheduled tasks
• Codeless Themes & Host-Managed Settings: Declarative JSON theme packages with zero script execution, plus host-rendered plugin settings forms, isolated key-value storage, and encrypted secrets management
Multi-Device Sync & Self-Hosted Foundation • Cross-Platform Instant Sync & Offline-First: Official apps for Web, macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android with no device limits; smooth offline writing with incremental sync, backed by SQLite and lossless ZIP import & export
• Zero-Cost Serverless & Docker Self-Hosting: Run 100% free on Cloudflare (~150k short notes & ~50k images), or deploy the exact same codebase on a private VPS / NAS with Docker in one click
• Storage Extension & Image Hosting: S3-compatible object storage (OSS) per instance; direct uploads via PicGo / PicList on desktop and CloudFlare ImgBed on web and desktop
• Desktop Auto-Backup & Enterprise Security: Scheduled local backups (multi-snapshot retention, optional .edgeever.enc encryption, and WebDAV off-site sync); multi-account physical workspace isolation, brute-force rate limiting, TOTP 2FA, and session management

Deployment

Cloudflare is the recommended zero-server deployment. Docker is available for users who prefer a VPS, NAS, or home server.

For Cloudflare, choose either of the following online deployment options:

Option A: Deploy with an AI Agent (Recommended)

Copy the prompt below directly into an AI Agent (such as Codex, Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, etc.). During execution, if access to GitHub or Cloudflare is required, review the requested permissions and follow the prompts to authorize access.

Deploy EdgeEver entirely through GitHub and Cloudflare:
1. Fork https://github.com/tianma-if/edgeever.
2. Create D1 `edgeever` and R2 `edgeever-resources` in Cloudflare.
3. In Workers & Pages, select "Start with Hello World!" to create and deploy a placeholder Worker
   named `edgeever`. Do not connect a Git repository yet.
4. Add the user's chosen password as the runtime Secret `EDGE_EVER_AUTH_PASSWORD`
   under Settings → Variables and Secrets, and deploy the Secret (preferably at least
   32 characters). The username defaults to `admin`.
5. Only after the Secret is deployed, open this Worker's Settings → Builds → Connect
   and connect the Fork's `main` branch.
6. In this Worker's Settings → Builds → API token, select or create the Cloudflare API token used for deployment, with D1 read/edit permission for the target account.
7. In the Fork's GitHub repository, open Actions → Update deployed EdgeEver, enable the workflow if prompted, and select Run workflow on `main`. After confirming in Cloudflare that the corresponding build succeeded and deployment completed, verify `/api/health` and `/api/openapi.json`, then log in with the administrator
   username and password.
   This workflow will automatically sync future stable releases and fixes.

Detailed requirements: AI Agent Cloudflare Deployment.

Option B: Manual Online Deployment

📖 Click to expand: 7-Step Web Manual Deployment Guide

Complete the following 7 web steps strictly in order:

  1. Fork the Repository: Click Fork at the top right of GitHub to fork EdgeEver into your personal account.
  2. Create Cloudflare Resources: Create D1 edgeever and R2 edgeever-resources.
  3. Create the Worker: In Cloudflare Workers & Pages, select Create application → Start with Hello World! to create and deploy a placeholder Worker named edgeever. Do not connect a Git repository yet.
  4. Set the Administrator Password: Under the Worker’s Settings → Variables and Secrets, add EDGE_EVER_AUTH_PASSWORD as type Secret and click Deploy. Its value is your chosen login password, preferably at least 32 characters. Complete this before connecting the Fork.
  5. Connect the Fork: In the existing Worker’s Settings → Builds → Connect, select the Fork and production branch main.
  6. Configure Deployment Permissions: In this Worker's Settings → Builds → API token, select or create the Cloudflare API token used for deployment, with D1 read/edit permission for the target account.
  7. Build & Verify: In the Fork's GitHub repository, open Actions → Update deployed EdgeEver, enable the workflow if prompted, and select Run workflow on main. After confirming in Cloudflare that the corresponding build succeeded and deployment completed, confirm /api/health returns 200 and verify login. This workflow will automatically sync future stable releases and fixes.

📖 For full step-by-step instructions and configuration details, see the Online Deployment Guide.

📌 View Cloudflare Deployment Notes (Custom Domain & Free R2 Allowance)

Custom Domain & Access: After deployment, you can directly use the default *.workers.dev domain assigned by Cloudflare, or attach your own custom domain in the Worker settings under Settings → Domains & Routes.

Cloudflare R2 Activation: Although Cloudflare R2 offers a generous free storage allowance that note-taking workloads remain completely within, you must first activate an R2 subscription and add a payment method. Cloudflare officially supports UnionPay, Visa, Mastercard, and other cards, as well as PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and other payment methods.

Option C: Docker on a VPS or NAS

Docker runs the same frontend, API routes, services, authentication, MCP implementation, and migrations as Cloudflare. The container uses SQLite with local files or S3-compatible attachment storage and supports amd64 and arm64. See Deploy EdgeEver with Docker and Self-hosting and Docker architecture.

Use the GitHub-hosted installer and the official GHCR image:

curl -fsSL https://edgeever.org/install.sh | bash

The command pulls the latest image, generates an administrator password, and starts EdgeEver with Docker Compose.

See the Docker deployment guide for manual deployment and configuration.

After installation, updates run automatically each day by default. To update manually, run ~/edgeever/update.sh on the deployment server.

Advanced Configuration & Management

Data Backup, Export & Migration

Whether for routine data backups, seamless cross-instance migration, or switching from existing note platforms, EdgeEver provides reliable, complete data mobility:

  • EdgeEver Native Backup & Restore: In the app, go to Profile -> Import and export to export or import an EdgeEver ZIP archive at any time. The extracted notes/ directory keeps clean plaintext Markdown files and attachments for local archival or direct reading, while internal structured metadata enables lossless full restoration across different EdgeEver instances. Importing preserves existing unrelated data on the target instance and automatically overwrites records with matching IDs.
  • Desktop Scheduled Auto-Backup & Off-Site Copy: Under Backup & Import in the desktop app, you can enable scheduled local backups (weekly or monthly) with a custom folder, snapshot retention count, and automatic creation of standard ZIP or encrypted .edgeever.enc archives whenever content changes, plus automatic WebDAV uploads to a NAS or compatible storage after each local backup.
  • Smooth Migration from Third-Party Apps: Whether importing via the native one-click GUI (supporting complete notes, hierarchies, and attachments from Evernote, Obsidian, Notion, SiYuan, flomo, Joplin, and generic Markdown files/folders) or migrating from Memos and other platforms via AI Agent & MCP, EdgeEver provides seamless, verified data mobility. See the Third-Party Notes Migration Guide.

AI & MCP Protocol Integration

Create an API token in Profile -> API / MCP (supporting full-workspace or granular per-notebook read/write permissions) and copy the Remote MCP configuration in one click to let AI Agents such as Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek Harness, and Antigravity securely manage your knowledge base within granted permissions. EdgeEver supports full CRUD for text notes, visual diagram notes (mind maps, flowcharts, and architecture diagrams), structured table notes, and native poster notes. Agents can also manage notebook hierarchies, tags, attachments, revision history, note templates, and AI instructions.

For client setup, token access levels, troubleshooting and suggested rules for agents, see Using EdgeEver with MCP clients.

💡 Inspiration: Make AI your true knowledge orchestrator and creative co-pilot—instantly turn concepts into interactive mind maps, flowcharts, architecture diagrams, and structured tables, while supplying private context to your AI Agents. Paired with EdgeEver’s powerful rich-text editing and elegant typography, AI-assisted content becomes beautifully structured, polished, and publication-ready knowledge assets.

Multi-Account Login & Storage Management

Once deployed, a single instance supports multi-account login.

The instance administrator can create, disable, or reset member accounts in Profile -> User accounts. Each member gets a fully isolated personal workspace, including notebooks, notes, attachments, Trash, import/export, and MCP tokens. An intuitive storage usage dashboard provides real-time visibility into attachment storage consumed across the whole instance as well as per account.

Storage Extension & Third-Party Image Hosting

  • OSS Object Storage: The instance owner can configure S3-compatible object storage under Settings → Advanced → OSS object storage. Changing storage does not migrate or affect existing attachments.
  • Desktop PicGo integration: The desktop app can hand inserted images to a PicGo or PicList server on this computer or on another machine you trust, such as a NAS. That server uploads them to GitHub, SM.MS, Upyun, Qiniu, or a custom image host. The address only needs to end with /upload, so a PicList behind a reverse proxy works too.
  • CloudFlare ImgBed on desktop and web: Upload inserted images directly to your self-hosted CloudFlare ImgBed using an API token. Folder templates support {Y}/{m}/{d} and {memoId}. Web access requires HTTPS and CORS allowing your EdgeEver origin and the Authorization header. Credentials stay in the current browser or desktop app; images are excluded from EdgeEver backups.

Plugins and Themes

Web and desktop apps support functional plugins and custom themes, installable from the official marketplace, GitHub, or a Manifest URL, with seamless sync across your workspace. Developers can extend capabilities using @edgeever/plugin-api; see the plugin development guide and marketplace submission policy.

Developer Guide & Contributing

Quick Start

bun install
bun run dev

Local development signs in automatically; fresh databases use owner / edgeever-local-dev. Log out to test the login screen.

Architecture & Tech Stack

Tech Stack

  • Bun workspace monorepo with Web, API, official site, and shared type package.
  • Frontend: Vite, React, React Router, TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, and Radix UI.
  • Editor: TipTap / ProseMirror with Markdown support.
  • Android app: Expo + React Native in apps/mobile, with SQLite local storage and incremental sync.
  • iOS app: Native SwiftUI in apps/ios (iOS 17+), with a packaged TipTap EditorBundle, GRDB local mirror/outbox, and Android-aligned shell chrome.
  • Native desktop app: Electron + Rust sidecar combines a consistent cross-platform experience with high-performance local data services; SQLite enables offline editing, incremental sync when back online, and local backups.
  • Web clipper: Manifest V3, Mozilla Readability, and Turndown for Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Firefox.
  • Backend: one Hono/Zod business application with REST API and Remote MCP; Cloudflare uses Workers/D1/R2, while Docker uses Bun/SQLite/local files or S3.
  • Official site: Astro static site in apps/site, deployable to Cloudflare Pages.

Project Structure

📁 Expand to view: Monorepo Project Structure 
apps/web          Vite + React frontend, offline drafts, and sync queue
apps/extension    Chrome/Edge/Firefox Manifest V3 web clipper
apps/api          Cloudflare Worker + Hono API, MCP endpoint
apps/mobile       Expo + React Native Android app
apps/ios          Native SwiftUI iOS app (TipTap EditorBundle, GRDB)
apps/desktop      Electron desktop shell, preload bridge, and native packaging
apps/site         Astro official website, deployable independently
packages/client   Shared API client for web and mobile apps
packages/shared   Shared types, Zod schemas, TipTap / Markdown conversion
crates/desktop-sidecar
                   Rust sidecar for local SQLite, offline data, backups, and resources
scripts           Wrangler wrapper, password hash, CLI, MCP stdio bridge, Evernote ENEX import
migrations        Shared append-only D1/SQLite database migrations
docs              Architecture, migration, and deployment docs
.github/workflows CI for web, mobile, iOS, desktop packaging, deployment, and releases
wrangler.toml     Cloudflare Workers, Assets, D1, R2 configuration

Data Storage Model

EdgeEver persists note content simultaneously across three formats to balance editing performance, open portability, and full-text search speed:

content_json      TipTap/ProseMirror document, the editor source of truth
content_markdown  API, Agent, export, and external ecosystem interoperability
content_text      Full-text search, summary generation, and indexing

Core Mechanisms & Design Decisions

  • Client-Side Silent Compression: To avoid consuming compute quota on serverless runtimes like Cloudflare Workers, image compression occurs in the Web client before upload (converting PNG/JPEG/WebP/AVIF to WebP when beneficial, max edge 2560px; original retained if compression does not reduce size). REST API and MCP endpoints store client-supplied binaries directly without additional server-side transcoding.
  • Offline-First & Sync Timing: Web and desktop clients automatically upload memo edits after 30 seconds of typing inactivity, and poll for remote changes every 5 minutes while visible; window refocus and manual refresh remain immediate. Configurable via DEFERRED_MEMO_SYNC_DELAY_MS and BACKGROUND_WORKSPACE_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS in apps/web/src/lib/workspace-refresh.ts.

Contributing Code

Community contributions are warmly welcome! Please keep the following guidelines in mind:

  • Please review the Contribution Guide before submitting code.
  • Deployment Isolation: If your GitHub Fork is also used to deploy EdgeEver, keep its main branch clean and deployment-only. Create a dedicated branch from official upstream/main for features/fixes and pull requests; do not develop on or run Sync fork directly on the deployment main.

Community and Feedback

  • Issues & Suggestions: For bugs, feature requests, and deployment questions, please submit to GitHub Issues to help the community build searchable solutions.

Telegram Community

Welcome to the EdgeEver community, bringing together developers and creators exploring vibe coding and AI. Join us to discuss cutting-edge AI productivity and best practices for personal knowledge bases.

👉 Join the EdgeEver Telegram group

Friendly Links

  • LINUX DO — A community for sharing technology and open-source projects.

Sponsor & Support

EdgeEver is a free and open-source project. Sustaining cross-platform client development, continuous device testing, code signing, and multi-runtime ecosystem maintenance requires ongoing dedication and resources.

  • Support EdgeEver — Voluntary donation via WeChat Pay or Alipay
  • Sponsors & Partners — Support infrastructure, developer tools, services, or community collaboration

Acknowledgements

  • EdgeEver's note-taking product design was also informed by the publicly available product experiences of mature note-taking tools such as Evernote and Notion. The related features were independently designed and implemented by EdgeEver.
  • The product design of mind-map and visual-diagram notes was informed by the publicly available product experiences of XMind and ProcessOn. These features were independently designed and implemented by EdgeEver.
  • EdgeEver's poster design workspace draws inspiration from Qiaomu Design by 向阳乔木 (joeseesun), and adapts its templates and typography engine under the MIT license.
  • The visual themes and typography of EdgeEver's image-sharing cards were inspired by Firefly Card (流光卡片). Thank you for the design inspiration.
  • EdgeEver's one-click WeChat publishing and featured article typography draw inspiration from gzh-design-skill by isjiamu. Thank you for the layout and design inspiration.

Trademark and Brand Use

The EdgeEver name, logo, and other brand identifiers distinguish the official project. Forks and modified versions may state that they are based on EdgeEver, but must not imply official status or mislead users. The open-source license does not grant trademark rights; other uses require prior written permission from the project maintainers.

Disclaimer

EdgeEver is an independent open-source note-taking application developed and maintained by individuals and the community. It is not affiliated with, authorized, sponsored, or endorsed by Evernote Corporation or its affiliates.

EdgeEver is self-hosted software. Except for official demo instances, project maintainers do not host, control, or review user content. Content stored or displayed by an instance is the responsibility of its users or operators and does not represent the maintainers' views.

## 主要更新

- 修复桌面端导入含多张图片的微信聊天记录后无法保存的问题。
- 设置页和桌面同步异常弹窗的问题反馈入口统一使用 GitHub 图标。
- 明确提示安装桌面更新会重启应用。
- Web 和桌面端的笔记列表、搜索结果和笔记链接选择器现在会显示无标题笔记的创建时间。感谢 @anhnt256 在 #874 中的贡献。

关联 Issue：#882, #813

## Key Changes

- Fix saving WeChat chat imports that contain multiple images on desktop.
- Use the GitHub icon for issue reporting in Settings and the desktop sync dialog.
- Clarify that applying a desktop update restarts the app.
- Show creation times for untitled notes in the note list, search results, and note-link pickers on web and desktop. Thanks to @anhnt256 in #874.

Related Issue: #882, #813

releases.name: v2.31.1
releases.body:
## 主要更新

- Android 端只显示一次 Google Play 更新提示。
- 导入笔记正文超出存储上限时，明确提示失败原因。感谢 @sivdead 在 #871 中的贡献。
- 在编辑器中点击图库图片时，保持图库工具栏打开。
- 缩小笔记本侧栏顶部控件，为笔记本列表腾出更多空间，并可从新建笔记菜单使用模板。
- 较早的保存完成同步时，保留图表和信息图中尚未保存的本地编辑。

关联 Issue：#876, #868

## Key Changes

- Show a single Google Play update prompt on Android.
- Identify oversized note bodies when an import exceeds the storage limit. Thanks to @sivdead in #871.
- Keep the gallery toolbar open when clicking images in the editor.
- Give the notebook list more space with a compact sidebar and a template shortcut in the new note menu.
- Preserve local diagram and infographic edits when an earlier save finishes syncing.

Related Issue: #876, #868

releases.name: v2.31.0
releases.body:
## 主要更新

- API Token 可限制在指定笔记本及其子笔记本内，并设为只读或读写。现有 Token 保留原有权限。
- 支持导入单个 Markdown 文件或整个目录。目录导入保留子目录层级，并解析本地附件和笔记间链接。
- 多维表格支持保存带筛选和多字段排序的命名视图，大表格滚动更流畅，链接字段可直接点击打开。
- 修复移动浏览器中无法选择 Joplin .jex 文件的问题，并避免 Evernote 任务标题和日期混入导入后的笔记正文。
- 更新 EdgeEver 标志、应用图标和 Demo 示例笔记，并调整合并笔记的分隔线。
- 减少重复同步和插件请求，重新部署到 Cloudflare 时默认保留正在生效的登录配置。

关联 Issue：#870, #837, #849, #851, #853

## Key Changes

- Restrict API tokens to selected notebooks and their sub-notebooks, with read-only or read/write access. Existing tokens retain their access.
- Import individual Markdown files or folders. Folder imports preserve subfolders and resolve local attachments and links between notes.
- Save named views with filters and multi-column sorting in structured tables, scroll large tables more smoothly, and open URLs directly from link cells.
- Fix selecting Joplin .jex files in mobile browsers and prevent Evernote task titles and dates from appearing in imported note text.
- Refresh the EdgeEver logo and app icons, update the Demo example notes, and refine separators in merged notes.
- Reduce redundant sync and plugin requests, and preserve active authentication settings by default when redeploying to Cloudflare.

Related

releases.name: v2.30.0
releases.body:
## 主要更新

- 修复桌面端附件缓存，避免下载中断留下不完整文件或影响后续预览。
- 修复桌面端合并笔记的同步与显示，恢复分隔线，并兼容旧版客户端合并的内容。
- 改进 Evernote 导入，支持超长标题，并可选择跳过异常或缺失附件以恢复其余笔记内容。
- 减少 Web 和桌面端打开工作区、编辑器、个人中心时的加载负担。
- 修复桌面端本地 AI 代理将背景信息误当成当前问题、只回复就绪确认的情况。

关联 Issue：#862

## Key Changes

- Repair desktop attachment caching so interrupted downloads cannot leave truncated files or corrupt later previews.
- Fix syncing and displaying merged desktop notes, including missing separators and recovery of content merged by older clients.
- Improve Evernote imports with support for long titles and an optional recovery mode that skips invalid or missing attachments while preserving the remaining note content.
- Reduce loading overhead when opening the workspace, editor, and personal center on Web and desktop.
- Fix desktop local agents confusing background context with the current request and replying with setup acknowledgments.

Related Issue: #862

releases.name: v2.28.2
releases.body:
## 主要更新

- 修复桌面端从笔记菜单导出 PDF 失败的问题。
- 修复实例离线时桌面端无法退出登录的问题，明确显示当前实例及切换登录方式。
- 修复信息图图库、画布和海报工作区的深色模式显示，改善编辑控件可见性并统一实心按钮配色。

关联 Issue：#857, #810

## Key Changes

- Restore desktop PDF export from note menus.
- Allow desktop sign-out when the instance is offline, and clarify the current instance and sign-in switching instructions.
- Fix dark appearance in infographic galleries, canvases, and poster workspaces, improve editing control visibility, and unify solid button colors.

Related Issue: #857, #810

aiSummary.oneLiner: A serverless, dual-view Markdown note-taking app that runs entirely on Cloudflare's free tier.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: EdgeEver is a highly portable, AI-integrated knowledge management platform deployed exclusively on Cloudflare Serverless architecture. It provides a classic three-pane layout featuring a dual-view editor that seamlessly toggles between rich text and Markdown source code. The application stores data transparently in SQLite, supporting unlimited nested notebooks, native Mermaid diagram rendering, and local WebP image compression. It deeply integrates with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), allowing external AI agents to read, summarize, and organize notes directly, while eliminating the need for expensive cloud servers or VPS hosting.
keyFeatures: Pure serverless architecture: Deploys entirely on Cloudflare Workers and Pages, requiring zero server maintenance or hosting costs.
Dual-view editing: Switches fluidly between a WYSIWYG rich text interface and raw, editable Markdown source code.
Native AI agent synergy: Integrates with MCP to allow external AI tools to securely read, summarize, and manage local notes.
Lossless ZIP portability: Exports the complete library, including nested folders and relative attachments, into a clean, restorable archive.
Smart local compression: Reduces image file sizes drastically via client-side WebP conversion before uploading to save storage.
One-click rich copy: Formats notes with inline CSS specifically for direct pasting into Substack, Medium, or newsletter editors.
